source_supported_interpretation.sessionStart: New Chat Tab creates a composer and its creation path dispatches sessionStart before explicit model submission; offline onboarding accessibility was not demonstrated.
source_supported_interpretation.stop: triggerStopHook is tied to a model turn ending (completed, aborted or error), not closing the window. No permitted offline UI operation was established to deliver this event.
source_supported_interpretation.sessionEnd: Closing a chat dispatches sessionEnd, a distinct event not configured as the pilot stop hook.
source_supported_interpretation.followup_message: The generated hook returns this field; Cursor stop handling may submit it as another model turn. Do not invoke a model turn under current restrictions.

possible_start_only_owner_steps: Use only the approved isolated disposable pilot window.
Cmd+Shift+P -> New Chat Tab; leave prompt empty and do not submit.
Stop at any sign-in, keychain or provider gate; do not change account/keychain/network settings.

required_actual_receipt.execution: Actual command execution with exit code 0; input includes correct hook_event_name, Cursor version, conversation/session identity and disposable workspace_roots
required_actual_receipt.output: Successful additional_context and followup_message containing the canonical bound NEXT output
insufficient: Hook event requested without command success/output
